points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers and amounts read correctly, with the currency beside the right figure?
Is each of the three Edit actions on the left end of its row?
Does the email layla@example.com stay left to right and unbroken?
Does the phone number +971 50 123 4567 keep its plus sign and order?
Does the IBAN AE07 0331 2345 6789 0123 456 stay in order, with its groups intact?
Is the name shown in Arabic or Latin without the layout breaking?
Is it clear which Edit belongs to which detail?
